en:
Well, at this point it goes without saying,
but you all voted correctly!

The blackened who killed Rantaro Amami
is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Kaede Akamatsu!
Good...
Wh-What...? Good?

What do you mean, good!?
Is this how you want it to end!?

Not really, but...it could've turned out a lot
worse. So this is fine, too.

I-It's not fine! This is super horrible!
The worst ever!
Yeah... How did it come to this?

Kaede, what would possess you to
do something like this?

Gonta no can accept this...
Not unless you explain...

Yeah... I won't be satisfied...
Until I hear it straight from you...
Kaede, please...

Okay... Please allow me a few more moments
of your time, then.

It's just like Shuichi said—I was after the
mastermind this entire time.

I wanted to kill the mastermind, and I thought
doing that would end the killing game...

But why did you try to kill them?
Maybe they could have been captured...

If it hadn't been for the time limit, I probably
would've done that...

But the time limit meant that capturing the
mastermind was less likely to work, y'know?

Cuz the mastermind could've just played
dumb to run out the clock and kill us all.
I...was worried about that happening.

So you sought to kill the
mastermind, instead?

I had made up my mind just before we set up
the cameras in the library.

I thought it was my last chance to save
everyone...

I couldn't let that chance pass me by. I had
to save everyone, no matter what.
Even if you had to kill someone?
That's right...

I thought that killing the mastermind was our
best shot at escaping this place together.
I...really believed it, too...
Kaede...
Oh, Kaede...it never dawned on you?

As soon as that thought entered your head,
Monokuma had you right where he wanted.

Because what mattered most to Monokuma
is that the killing game started.

Regardless of your reasons, the moment you
felt the urge to kill, you had already lost.

You agreed to be part of this killing game
when you allowed murder to fill your heart.
W-Wait. To put it like that...

But he's not wrong. She's the reason the
killing game finally started.

But...if Kaede hadn't done anything, we'd
all be dead by now...
Kaede save everyone... We no can blame her.
I know! You don't need to remind me!

That's why I'm so...pissed off! Pissed off
at myself for being so...so useless!

Kokichi...that's enough.
I can see through your act.
...Whoops. That obvious, huh?
But...Kokichi is right. I was being played.

And I didn't even kill the mastermind. I killed
one of our <CLT=cltSTRONG>dear friends<CLT=cltNORMAL>, instead...

What I did was so terrible...
So...unforgivable...

I took an innocent life! I'm nothing but
a horrible murderer!

You should all hate, blame, and be disgusted
by me!
Kaede, please calm down!

After we found Rantaro's body, when I
realized he wasn't the mastermind...

I thought about ending this by confessing
to you what I had done...

But...I couldn't. Because of Monokuma's
<CLT=cltSTRONG>First Blood Perk<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I see... If you'd confessed there and 
then, you would've been able to leave...

But you decided you couldn't leave this 
place by yourself, so you kept quiet.

Because of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>First Blood Perk<CLT=cltNORMAL>, you were
forced to hide the truth from us.
Yeah, that's right...

So the <CLT=cltSTRONG>First Blood Perk<CLT=cltNORMAL> worked against 
the blackened rather than for them.
But...at the same time, I thought...

If I did this for everyone, then instead of
making things easier by confessing...

I thought I should lie to you all, so it would
motivate you to keep moving forward.

Is that the reason for the trial?
To reveal the mastermind?

I felt like if I didn't do this, then Rantaro's
death would have been meaningless.

We were searching for both the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> and
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL> during this class trial.
Ah, Kaede did mention that.

But that's why I want to end all of the
terrible things happening to us!

I'll defeat the mastermind and end 
this dumb killing game!
I'll...I'll even use this class trial to do that!

I never wanted to keep my crime a secret...
I was going to tell you all eventually...

But before I did, I wanted to expose the
mastermind first...

Then the killing game would've ended, and
<CLT=cltSTRONG>everyone but me<CLT=cltNORMAL> would be saved.

I thought that was the best way I could
atone for killing Rantaro...

...This is my fault. I was wrong.
There was no mastermind...

You were wrong...? But didn't you say 
the mastermind was one of us?

That's what I thought at first...
But in the end, we have nothing.

No one made any moves at the
time limit, the trial was useless...

Even when Shuichi was about to be
voted as the blackened...
Still, they did not appear.
Yeesh, that seriously was a close one.

If Kaede had just kept her mouth shut,
we'd all be dead right now.

No way. There has to be something else 
we can discuss. We just gotta think.
Right, Shuichi?

On the other hand, she's only in this mess cuz
she decided to say something at that moment.

I wanted to protect Kaede, but I
also wanted to unmask the mastermind.

But even when the killer was about
to be condemned, they remained hidden.

That has to mean that the
mastermind is not among us after all.

So Kaede had the wrong idea 
the whole time...

All her actions were taken under
Shuichi's flawed logic.
That's why this is my fault.

All of this happened because
my detective work was wrong.
If I hadn't been so stupid...

If I never said anything about a
mastermind to Kaede...

...Rantaro wouldn't have died...
and Kaede wouldn't be a murderer!
This is all my fault!
No, it's not.
...Kaede...?
I killed him. Not you.
...Right? Didn't I?

But, Kaede, why did you set such
a convoluted trap?

If your intent was to kill the mastermind, there
was no reason for you to <CLT=cltSTRONG>cover your tracks<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Isn't it obvious? It's because...she didn't want
Shuichi to know.

Of course, but...I didn't want everyone else
to know, either.

Because...I said I wanted to escape this
place with everyone.

But you guys wouldn't want to be friends
with a girl who killed someone, would you?
Be...friends?
Kaede...put a lot of thought into this.

She put so much thought into this, it drove
her to commit murder like a lunatic...
God, you're such a dumbass...

I know, right?
I'm such an idiot...

We only survived the time limit because of
that idiocy...
Y-Yes! We still alive thanks to you!

Kaede...I didn't know how, but
I wanted to get out of here with you.
I wanted...to be friends.
I'm so sorry...

So you're saying...everything you did
was because you were thinking of us?

And you hid that you killed him just 
to stay and help us...? How did things—
Alright, alright! That's it!
What?

Wh-What do you mean...?
What do you mean...that's it?
Father, are you getting bored?

You know how Pops gets... He can't
stand this kinda tearjerker schlock.
I can't...stop...crying...!

Teeheehee... I see nothing gets past my
adorable little cubs.

I don't even let appetizers get past me!
Especially if someone else bought 'em!

But we can't let this boring display
grind the action to a halt, so...
...time to make things interesting.
Make things...interesting?

And now, the moment you've all been
waiting for! <CLT=cltSTRONG>Punishment Time<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

P-Punishment...? You mean...Kaede's
execution!?

N-No friggin' way!
There's no way we'll let you do that!
Exisals assemble!
Aaaaaaah!

Punishment Time is a sacred segment.
You're not allowed to interfere.

And if ya even try to interfere, we'll just
crush youse wit' these here Exisals!

I-It's cruel, but...it's probably better if
one person dies instead of everyone...

Like hell am I just gonna sit here 
and do what you say!

Kaede fought with her life on the line!
And so will I!

Gonta will face you all! Times like this
are why Gonta became strong!

Gentlemen never back down, and
neither will Gonta!

Th-This is the perfect chance to test out
my <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> skills on machines!
Y-Yeah! I'll help! I can—
Everyone, stop!!!
Please...just stop.
But Kaede...

Enough, you guys...
I've...already prepared myself.
You're...giving up?
But why...?

You said...you'd never give up...
That we'd get out of here together.
That's what you said, Kaede...

So why are you giving up now!?
Did you mean what you said!?

I know we can do something!
Don't give up until the end!
...I'm not giving up. Because I have you.
...What?

Even after I'm gone...<CLT=cltSTRONG>my wish<CLT=cltNORMAL> will still
be here.

So I'm counting on you all! I'm entrusting
<CLT=cltSTRONG>my wish<CLT=cltNORMAL> to every one of you!

I believe in you! I believe that you all will
make it through this, somehow!

You guys better live! Don't go dying on me
now!

End this ridiculous killing game, survive,
and get the hell out of this place!

And then...be friends after you escape, okay?
I think you'll all be the best of friends.
Affirmative, Kaede...
I will do my utmost to fulfill your final request.

I won't give up! I'll get out of here, no matter
what!

Gonta work hard and keep friends safe till
very end!
Well, Kaede, you definitely weren't boring.
Now then...let's get started.

I have a special punishment prepared for the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Kaede Akamatsu!

W-Wait, wait a second!
Kaede, please, don't...
Shuichi, you better not lose.

You can't lose to this killing game!
I know you can beat it!

Let's give it everything we've got!
It's...PUNISHMENT TIIIME!

I believe in you guys!
So please, believe in yourself!
...Okay? It's a promise.
